description:
Sends a Nudge email now to Clients who haven't finished sending records for a Quarter (waiting or partial), at most one per Client per day. confirm:false (default) lists who would get one and who is excluded (no email, nudged today, paused); confirm:true sends.
Use this when: chasing up everyone outstanding, or named Clients, now — an extra reminder outside the plan.

clients.description: Client names, emails or references; default: everyone outstanding

confirm.description: false (default) = dry run: shows what would happen, changes nothing. true = do it.

idempotency_key.description: Optional; reuse when retrying so the change happens once.

only_status.description: e.g. waiting = only those who've sent nothing

quarter.description: Quarter like "2026-27 Q3". Default: the Quarter whose HMRC deadline is next.

name: send_nudges_now
title: Nudge now
